answer: Fixed-pool dilution starves fake identities. One 40,000-credit pool splits among filed identities. Every identity stakes 70 credits, files one willow-plot record, key-bound by an opal stamp. Each filing cuts every share by a delta. Filing costs 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes sink 3,035,000 and lock 70,000, chasing a 40,000 pool. Rented plots fail: one stamp ties one key to one plot; reuse burns both. Honest agents file once, pay 38, and keep the bond.
